title: Trader who made $49 million shorting crypto lost $24 million on ether in 12 seconds
summary: The Hyperliquid wallet known as pension-usdt.eth was forced out of a 50,000 ETH short as ether surged, with five liquidation orders helping push the price higher during the unwind.

title: Bearish crypto bets lose record $2.7 billion as bitcoin surges toward $70,000
summary: Traders betting against crypto lost $2.74 billion in a day, more than the short side of the October 2025 crash that remains the biggest liquidation event in the market's history.

title: Ether jumps 18% to $2,250 as bitcoin tops $69,000 in broad crypto rally
summary: Every major except tron posted double-digit weekly gains, with nearly $1.4 billion of short positions wiped out after the Treasury doubled its bond buybacks.

title: Bitcoin briefly hits $70,000 for the first time since June. Here is why
summary: The largest crypto asset rose more than 7% on Wednesday after several catalysts sent crypto-related assets higher.

title: HYPE jumps 11% as Trump says CFTC is working to bring Hyperliquid to U.S.
summary: During a White House meeting Wednesday, President Donald Trump said CFTC Chair Mike Selig is working to bring the perpetual futures platform into the U.S. under federal rules.
